lines.en: label amimaid50:
scene amilockerroom1
: Ahh! Boy am I glad to be out of that stuffy maid outfit. Looking cute sure can be exhausting sometimes.
lines.zh: : 啊!总算脱掉那身闷死人的女仆装了。扮可爱有时候真的很累。

lines.en: : Ami, I don’t think I’m supposed to be in here.
lines.zh: : Ami,我觉得我不该出现在这里。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom2
: You can be wherever I want you to be! Plus, it’s not like you wandered in on your own. I dragged you in myself, which I am allowed to do since I work here!
lines.zh: : 我想让你在哪你就能在哪!再说了,又不是你自己晃进来的,是我亲手把你拖进来的——我在这里上班,我有权这么做!

lines.en: : It’s the exact type of situation we were shooting for when you decided I was allowed to work at the maid cafe!
lines.zh: : 这不正是当初你获准来女仆咖啡厅上班时,我们俩求之不得的场景吗!

lines.en: : I decided you were allowed to work at the maid cafe so you could make more money. Not so you could strip down to your underwear in a locker room while everyone else is clothed and working.
lines.zh: : 我批准你来上班,是为了让你多赚点钱。而不是让你在所有人穿着衣服干活的时候,在更衣室里只穿着内衣晃荡。

lines.en: : Huh. Guess I’m just misremembering then.
lines.zh: : 咦。那大概是我记岔了。

lines.en: As you can see, Ami is mostly naked. Which means I am mostly in danger.
lines.zh: 如你所见,Ami 基本上全裸。这意味着我基本上危在旦夕。

lines.en: But it’s not just because the only thing that gets her blood pumping is blood of a similar type and that she could very well attack me at any given moment-
lines.zh: 但这不仅是因为唯一能让她血液沸腾的,就是同类相吸的血,而且她随时可能扑上来——

lines.en: It’s because, as I just mentioned to her, we are not alone.
lines.zh: 更因为,我刚刚跟她说过:我们不是独自一人。

lines.en: Unfortunately, her head is so empty that anything apart from compliments or words of affirmation goes in one ear, out the other, and then ultimately falls to its death on the floor.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是,她的脑袋空空如也,除了夸奖和肯定的话,什么都进不了左耳——进了右耳,最终摔死在地板上。

lines.en: But hey, on the bright side, she really does seem to be on at least...mostly good behavior today. And it’s not like she’s putting on an act about the whole “stuffy costume” thing.
lines.zh: 不过往好处想,她今天的表现确实至少……大体良好。而且「制服闷热」这茬也不像是在演。

lines.en: I’ve never dressed in a maid outfit before, nor do I intend to, but just being in these clothes in this weather is enough to make me start questioning my decision to go out today.
lines.zh: 女仆装我从来没穿过,也不打算穿,但这种天气光是穿着衣服站在这,就足以让我怀疑今天出门的决定。

lines.en: Damn the sun and damn my love for maids.
lines.zh: 该死的太阳,也该死的我这女仆控。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom3
: You know, even if we don’t see eye to eye on why you let me get a job here, I’ve gotta say that life has gotten pretty interesting ever since then-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,就算我们在「你为什么准我上班」这事上达不成共识,我还是得说,从那以后人生变得有趣多了——

lines.en: : Which is super great since being stuck inside of that house all the time was starting to get really boring.
lines.zh: : 这超棒,毕竟一直闷在家里都快把我闷出病了。

lines.en: : I want to stop you for a second there and just throw out the fact that you can’t just say we don’t see eye to eye on my reasons for doing things. Only I know what I think.
lines.zh: : 且慢,我得打断一下,顺便指出:你不许张口就说我们在我的动机上达不成共识。只有我知道我在想什么。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom4
: But what if I have super awesome mind-reading powers like Anya Forger and just never told you about them?
lines.zh: : 可要是我有 Anya Forger 那种超棒读心术、只是一直没告诉你呢?

lines.en: : That would certainly explain a lot of things, for sure. But I know it can’t be true based on the fact that you haven’t stabbed any of your classmates yet.
lines.zh: : 那倒是能解释很多事,没错。但我知道不可能,因为你的同学至今一个都没被你捅过。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom5
: Stabbed?! Why would I stab any of them?! Do I really look like the stabbing type to you? With these scrawny arms? You know me better than that.
lines.zh: : 捅人?!我为什么要捅他们?!我看起来像会捅人的类型吗?就凭这两条细胳膊?你明明了解我。

lines.en: : I know you very well. Which means I also know how...protective you are over me.
lines.zh: : 我很了解你。这意味着我也知道你对我有多……保护欲过剩。

lines.en: scene norikotime23
scene amilockerroom6
: And by “protective” I mean terrifyingly attached to the point where it is almost intimidating.
lines.zh: : 而所谓「保护欲过剩」,我的意思是依恋到近乎吓人的程度。

lines.en: : And by “almost” I mean it can be very intimidating.
lines.zh: : 而所谓「近乎」,我的意思是它可以非常吓人。

lines.en: : I mean...sure. I get it. But that still doesn’t mean I’d hurt anybody. Ayane’s been in love with you forever and I haven’t stabbed her yet.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧,我懂。但这不代表我会伤害任何人。Ayane 爱你爱了那么多年,我不也没捅过她。

lines.en: : Good. Continue not doing that for the rest of forever and we won’t have a problem.
lines.zh: : 很好。余生继续保持,我们就相安无事。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom7
: Hey, is something going on? You seem a little weird today.
lines.zh: : 嘿,是不是出什么事了?你今天有点怪。

lines.en: : As the only one fully clothed in this room, I beg to differ.
lines.zh: : 作为这间屋子里唯一一个穿戴整齐的人,恕难苟同。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom8
: Technically, it isn’t weird to be undressed in a locker room. So you can go ahead and get naked too if that makes you feel better, Sensei. It’s only natural.
lines.zh: : 严格来说,在更衣室里脱衣服不算怪。所以要是那样能让你好受点,Sensei,你也可以脱光。这是很自然的事。

lines.en: : I’m good. It’s risky enough being in here like this...and I doubt I’d be able to talk myself out of anyone walking in if I wasn’t wearing anything.
lines.zh: : 我就不必了。像这样待在这里已经够冒险了……而且我怀疑,要是我一丝不挂,万一有人进来,我根本没法自圆其说。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: So don’t talk your way out of it! No harm in Uta-chan or Osako-chan knowing how much you love your niece.
lines.zh: : 那就别自圆其说嘛!让 Uta 酱或 Osako 酱知道你多爱你的侄女,又没什么坏处。

lines.en: : There is when the way I love you transcends the way I’m supposed to.
lines.zh: : 有坏处——因为我爱你的方式,超出了我应该有的那种。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. You love me exactly how you’re supposed to. And anyone who has a problem with that just doesn’t understand.
lines.zh: : 才没有。你爱我的方式刚刚好。任何有意见的人,只是不理解而已。

lines.en: : To be honest, if you didn’t love me the right way after all this time, I’d probably go insane! So be happy that you do!
lines.zh: : 说实话,过了这么久你要是还没爱上我,我可能会疯掉!所以你该庆幸你爱!

lines.en: : Wow, awesome. That’s so reassuring. Thanks, Ami.
lines.zh: : 哇,太好了。真是让人安心。谢了,Ami。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom14
else:
: You could always grow a backbone and just have sex with me already. Then you wouldn’t have anything to hide at all.
lines.zh: : 你其实随时可以挺起脊梁,直接和我做。那样你就完全没有需要隐瞒的东西了。

lines.en: : Please don’t do that.
lines.zh: : 求你别这样。

lines.en: : Do what? Remind you that I want you to fuck my tight, virgin pussy while I wrap my legs around your waist and dig my nails into your back? Doesn’t that sound hot?
lines.zh: : 做什么?提醒你我想让你干我那紧致的、未经人事的小穴——趁我用双腿缠住你的腰、指甲抠进你的背?这不性感吗?

lines.en: scene amilockerroom9
: Just you and me...and whoever else decides to walk in. But of course, they’d be forced to watch since you’d never even think about giving any of our DNA to somebody else, right?
lines.zh: : 只有你和我……还有任何决定推门进来的人。不过没关系,她们只能看着——因为你连想都不会想,把我们的 DNA 给其他任何人,对吧?

lines.en: : You need to stop.
lines.zh: : 你得适可而止。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom10
: No.
: Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : Why would I stop? I’m in the midst of puberty and have so many feelings I need help understanding. If only there was someone who could help me learn.
lines.zh: : 我为什么要停?我正在青春期,有一大堆感情需要有人帮我理解。可惜没有一个人能教我。

lines.en: : Preferably someone who’s familiar with my body so I know I’d be in good hands. And is also related to me and has glasses and is named Sensei.
lines.zh: : 最好是一个熟悉我身体的人,这样我才知道自己被交到了好人手里。还得和我有血缘、戴眼镜、名字叫 Sensei。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom11
: Basically, you should fuck me or I am going to go crazy. Like, for real.
lines.zh: : 总而言之,要么干我,要么我要疯了。来真的那种。

lines.en: : Like...for real.
lines.zh: : 就是……来真的那种。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom13
: Like, for real.
lines.zh: : 就是,来真的。

lines.en: : I’m going fucking insane.

lines.en: scene amilockerroom14
: Anyway, regardless of how risky you think this is, I don’t see it as a bad idea at all.
lines.zh: : 总之,不管你觉得这有多冒险,我完全不觉得这是个坏主意。

lines.en: : Yeah, of course you don’t. I’m 99%% sure the only reason you became a maid in the first place was because you knew I had a thing for them.
lines.zh: : 是,你当然不觉得。我有 99%% 的把握,你当初来当女仆的唯一原因,就是知道我对女仆有好感。

lines.en: : Sounds pretty considerate if I do say so myself. Which I do because I am very considerate and am always putting your needs ahead of mine.
lines.zh: : 听起来相当贴心,如果我自己夸自己的话。而我的确要夸,因为我非常贴心,永远把你的需求放在我的前面。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom15
: This really was a nice change, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这确实是个不错的改变。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize just how much I’d enjoy it until I started working here.
lines.zh: : 直到来这里上班,我都不知道我会这么享受。

lines.en: : Now, I don’t know if I’ll ever be able to stop.
lines.zh: : 现在,我都不知道自己还能不能停下来。

lines.en: : I might just stay a maid for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 说不定我就一辈子当女仆了。

lines.en: : Do you think I could live like that, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我能这样过下去吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : I think you might reach a point age-wise where it isn’t really feasible anymore. But hey, follow your dreams and all that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你迟早会到一个年纪,那样就不再可行了。不过嘛,追梦这种事,随你。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom16
: And if you’re lucky, you might even grow into a new uniform one day.
lines.zh: : 而且你要是走运,说不定哪天还能长进一套新制服里。

lines.en: : Now, that was just plain rude.
lines.zh: : 这话说得就实在有点没礼貌了。

lines.en: : And in here you’ll find-
lines.zh: : 而在这里,你会发现——

lines.en: scene amilockerroom17
: Something that is...totally not safe for work...
lines.zh: : 一件……完全不宜在上班时间看的东西……

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Oh, hey! Don’t mind me. It was just a little too hot in the uniform, so I decided to take it off for my break since Sensei was cool with it. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦,嗨!别管我。制服里实在太热了,所以我决定休息时间先脱掉,反正 Sensei 都同意了。对吧,Sensei?

lines.en: : I had nothing to do with this.
lines.zh: : 这件事和我没有任何关系。

lines.en: : See? This is totally normal for him. It doesn’t even register as inappropriate.
lines.zh: : 看?这对他来说完全正常。甚至触发不了他一丝一毫的「不合适」警报。

lines.en: : Anyway, did you guys need something? Because you’re kind of interrupting our conversation right now.
lines.zh: : 总之,你们俩有事吗?你们现在有点打断我们谈话了。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom18
: Uhh...Uta was giving me a tour of the place since I’ve been thinking about coming to work here.
lines.zh: : 呃……Uta 带我参观这里,因为我一直在考虑要不要来这里上班。

lines.en: : You probably shouldn’t bother. It’s a lot of really hard work and we have enough employees already.
lines.zh: : 你最好别费劲。这里活特别累,而且我们人手已经够了。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom19
: Yeah, I can decide for myself...but thanks for the heads up.
lines.zh: : 我的事我自己会决定……不过谢谢提醒。

lines.en: : So, uhh...this probably wasn’t the most normal thing to walk into, but I swear that nothing like this has ever happened before and, if it has, I totally don’t know about it.
lines.zh: : 那个……呃……推门看到这一幕确实不太正常,但我发誓以前从没发生过这种事——就算有过,我也完全不知道。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom20
: It’s whatever. I’m not even surprised given that she drags him into dressing rooms with her as well. Besides, it’s not like Sensei thinks anything of it. Just look at him.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。她连试衣间都要把人拖进去,我一点都不意外。再说了,Sensei 根本不当回事。看看他那副样子。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Chika. It might not be official, but Ami’s held the number one spot in the Sensei love ranking ever since it was established.
lines.zh: : 这我就不知道了,Chika。虽然不算官宣,但自从「Sensei 爱慕排行榜」设立以来,第一名一直是 Ami。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom21
: Wait, Ami is number one?! And I’m only in the top five?! Are you fucking kidding me?!
lines.zh: : 等等,Ami 是第一?!我才进前五?!你在跟我开玩笑吗?!

lines.en: : I...I see you’re already familiar with the ranking! That’s good!
lines.zh: : 我……我看你已经很熟悉排行榜了!很好!

lines.en: : How much did she pay you for that spot?! I’ll pay double!
lines.zh: : 那个位置你收了她多少钱?!我出双倍!

lines.en: : Chika, you’re poor. And also shouldn’t be fighting for this right now.
lines.zh: : Chika,你没钱。而且你现在也不该争这个。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom22
: Oh. Uh...yeah. I mean, it’s just a stupid ranking after all. I don’t even need to be on it or whatever. Plus, it’s, like...not even official.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……也对。反正只是个愚蠢的排行榜。我甚至不需要上榜什么的。再说,那什么……也不是官宣。

lines.en: : R...Right!
: So, umm...anyway, this is the locker room. And when Ami isn’t busy trying to get weird with her uncle, it’s where we stash our stuff and change into our uniforms and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 那么,呃……总之,这里是更衣室。Ami 不忙着跟她叔叔搞怪的时候,我们就在这里放东西、换制服什么的。

lines.en: : If you do decide that this might be the place for you, you’ll get a locker along the wall and-
lines.zh: : 要是你觉得这里适合你,墙上会有一个你的柜子,然后——

lines.en: scene amilockerroom23
: And that’s it! Locker room tour over! Bye, guys! Sensei and I were talking about important family business and, I don’t want to be rude, but you’re kind of still in the way.
lines.zh: : 好了!更衣室参观到此结束!拜拜两位!Sensei 和我在聊重要的家务事,虽然不想失礼,但你们有点挡道了。

lines.en: : Oh. Sorry, Ami. I’m used to important family conversations being held with clothes on. I didn’t realize it was different for other families.
lines.zh: : 哦。抱歉,Ami。我习惯的重要家庭谈话,一般是穿着衣服进行的。原来别人家不一样。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I understand. Bye.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我理解。拜拜。

lines.en: : Huh. My family didn’t have many talks like that, but I’m pretty sure we would’ve kept our clothes on too. But hey, different strokes for different folks, I guess.
lines.zh: : 咦,我们家倒是没有多少那种谈话,但我敢肯定我们也会穿着衣服。不过嘛,人各有志,我猜。

lines.en: : Ugh, whatever. Let’s just go.
lines.zh: : 啧,随便。我们走吧。

lines.en: : Wait! Don’t you want to try on the uniform first?! I have an extra! And if it sounds like I’m excited to see you in it, it’s probably just because I really like maids!
lines.zh: : 等等!你不想先试试制服吗?!我有多的!要是听上去我很想看你穿,那只是因为我真的很喜欢女仆!

lines.en: : That would be a bad idea since Sensei is in here and it would be like, totally weird for a teenager he’s not related to to get undressed in front of him.
lines.zh: : 那可是个坏主意,Sensei 就在这屋里,一个和他毫无血缘的少女在他面前脱衣服,会显得非常怪。

lines.en: : Right, yeah. And it’s not weird at all for his niece to do that.
lines.zh: : 对,是啊。而他的侄女这么做,就完全不怪。

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 完全正确。

lines.en: : Do you seriously just not understand sarcasm at all?
lines.zh: : 你是不是真的完全听不懂反讽?

lines.en: : Guess not. See you in school, Chika!
lines.zh: : 大概吧。学校见,Chika!

lines.en: : Whatever. Come on, Uta.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。走了,Uta。

lines.en: : Wait! Noooooo!
lines.zh: : 等等!不要啊————!

lines.en: : The nerve of some people. Not realizing when they should both knock and mind their own business. We’re clearly in the middle of something here.
lines.zh: : 有些人真是没分寸。既不知道什么时候该敲门,也不知道什么时候该管好自己的事。我们明显正在忙。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom24
: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : 什么?你那样看着我干嘛?

lines.en: : There was no reason for you to act that way toward them, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你完全没有必要那样对她们,Ami。

lines.en: : It would be one thing for Uta since the two of you see each other all the time and she can just laugh it off...But Chika doesn’t know you that well. And you don’t want her to be your enemy.
lines.zh: : 换成 Uta 倒还说得过去,你们俩天天见面,她笑一笑就翻篇了……但 Chika 没那么了解你。你不会想让她成为你的敌人的。

lines.en: : Why would she be my enemy? All I did was ask for some alone time with my uncle. If she takes that the wrong way, that’s on her.
lines.zh: : 她为什么会成为我的敌人?我不过是想要一点和叔叔独处的时间。她要是想歪了,那是她的问题。

lines.en: : This might be the locker room, but it’s also the break room. And I’m on break right now, which means I shouldn’t have to worry about work-related stuff.
lines.zh: : 这里虽然是更衣室,也是休息室。而我现在正在休息,也就是说我不该操心工作相关的事。

lines.en: : You just could have been a little nicer. That’s all I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 你只是本可以稍微客气一点。我只想说这个。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom25
: Mm...you’re right. Maybe I was a little too pushy just now?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你说得对。也许我刚才确实有点太咄咄逼人了?……

lines.en: : I should probably go and apologize...
lines.zh: : 我应该去道个歉……

lines.en: : You should probably get dressed first. Because as happy as the customers might be to see a maid in her underwear, I can’t imagine your coworkers would feel the same.
lines.zh: : 你应该先把衣服穿好。因为就算客人们乐意见到一个穿内衣的女仆,我实在无法想象你的同事也会这么想。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine I’d have any coworkers after pulling a stunt like that.
lines.zh: : 出了那种事之后,我大概也不会有同事了。

lines.en: : I’ll just apologize whenever I see Chika next. I don’t have anything against her. In fact, I kinda look up to her in a bunch of ways.
lines.zh: : 下次见到 Chika,我再道歉好了。我对她没有任何意见。事实上,我在很多方面还挺仰慕她的。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom26
: She’s gorgeous...and cool...and popular...and can pull off, like...any outfit ever. Plus, she’s smart and has really nice boobs that I am only kind of jealous of.
lines.zh: : 她那么漂亮……那么酷……那么受欢迎……而且随便什么衣服都能驾驭。对了,她又聪明,胸又漂亮,让我有点嫉妒。

lines.en: : And by “kind of” I mean I want her boobs.
lines.zh: : 所谓「有点」,意思是:我想要她的胸。

lines.en: : Or any boobs.
lines.zh: : 或者任何胸。

lines.en: : But alas...Ami is a washboard...
lines.zh: : 可惜啊……Ami 是洗衣板……

lines.en: : I’m not going to weigh in on the whole apologizing thing since this doesn’t really have to do with me, but I’m glad to hear you’re considering it.
lines.zh: : 道歉的事我就不发表意见了,这跟我没什么关系,但听到你在考虑,我很欣慰。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom27
: Of course. I’m one of the good guys.
lines.zh: : 当然。我是好人阵营的。

lines.en: : But you’re wrong about this not having anything to do with you.
lines.zh: : 但你说这跟你没关系,这点你说错了。

lines.en: : I thought it was pretty clear Chika was jealous back there. And that’s probably why I acted the way I did. I doubt I would have snapped if it was someone who didn’t like the same person as me.
lines.zh: : 刚才 Chika 显然在嫉妒。大概那就是我反应过激的原因。我怀疑,要是换成一个不喜欢同一个人的,我不至于炸毛。

lines.en: : Have you ever considered maybe...not caring about how other girls feel about me? People can’t help who they fall for. You shouldn’t resent them for that.
lines.zh: : 你有没有考虑过……别去管其他女孩对我的感觉?人没法控制自己爱上谁。你不该为此怨恨她们。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom28
: I don’t resent anybody. Like I said, I admire Chika.
lines.zh: : 我没有怨恨任何人。我说了,我仰慕 Chika。

lines.en: : I just get a little irked when I think about the two of you together and go into protective mode. But it’s not like that’s a new thing.
lines.zh: : 只是一想到你们俩在一起,我就有点烦躁,进入保护模式。但这不是什么新鲜事了。

lines.en: : I just want you to be safe. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你安全。仅此而已。

lines.en: : And you don’t think I’d be safe with Chika?
lines.zh: : 所以你觉得,和 Chika 在一起我就不安全?

lines.en: : Right.
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Because she’s a teenager.
lines.zh: : 因为她是未成年人。

lines.en: : And you’re not?
lines.zh: : 你不是吗?

lines.en: : I’m different. I’m your niece. We live together. If you lived with Chika, it would raise some eyebrows.
lines.zh: : 我不一样。我是你的侄女。我们住在一起。你要是和 Chika 住在一起,会引人侧目。

lines.en: : So when Chika graduates high school-
lines.zh: : 那等 Chika 高中毕业——

lines.en: : Actually, when all of the girls graduate high school, you’ll be okay with me dating them?
lines.zh: : 或者说,等所有女孩都高中毕业了,你就能接受我和她们交往了?

lines.en: scene amilockerroom29
: Hmm...
: Are you actually thinking about it?
lines.zh: : 你居然真的在认真想?

lines.en: : Of course. You asked me a serious question, so it’s my responsibility to give you a serious answer.
lines.zh: : 当然。你问了我一个严肃的问题,所以给你一个严肃的答案是我的责任。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom28
: And that serious answer is no.
lines.zh: : 而这个严肃的答案是:不行。

lines.en: : I won’t ever be okay with you dating anyone other than me because I am the one you love the most and we are meant to be together. The end.
lines.zh: : 除了我,你和任何人交往,我永远都不会接受——因为我是你最爱的人,我们注定要在一起。完。

lines.en: : You almost got me, though.
lines.zh: : 不过差一点,你就唬住我了。

lines.en: : I wasn’t trying to get you, Ami. I was trying to help you understand that I can be safe with other people. It doesn’t have to be you.
lines.zh: : 我没想唬你,Ami。我只是想让你明白:我和其他人在也可以很安全。那个人不一定是你。

lines.en: : What are you talking about? Of course it does.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么?当然一定是你。

lines.en: : No, it doesn’t. And to be honest, you’ve been getting way too clingy lately. Which is crazy since you were already clingy to start with.
lines.zh: : 不,不一定。而且说实话,你最近黏人得有点过头了。这很离谱,因为你本来就够黏了。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom30
: I’m serious. You need to start letting me breathe.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。你得开始让我喘口气了。

lines.en: : I love you. But my world doesn’t revolve around you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。但我的世界不是围着你转的。

lines.en: : Yes it does...
lines.zh: : 它就是……

lines.en: : I do everything for you. You’d...be nowhere without me.
lines.zh: : 我为你做了一切。没有我,你……哪儿都去不了。

lines.en: : You’d have no clean clothes and live off of instant noodles. The trash would pile up and the house would start smelling weird.
lines.zh: : 你会没有干净衣服穿、靠泡面度日。垃圾会堆成山,房子会开始发臭。

lines.en: : You’d have to warm the bath all by yourself and you always complain when you have to do that. And that’s not even counting all of the times you’ve asked for help with-
lines.zh: : 浴水你得自己烧,而你每次自己烧都要抱怨半天。这还没算上你找我帮忙的那些次数——

lines.en: : How can I get better at anything if you’re always just...going to do everything for me?
lines.zh: : 你要是什么都替我做,我还怎么在任何事上变好?

lines.en: : ...What?
: Why would you need to get better?
lines.zh: : 你为什么需要变好?

lines.en: : Who told you that you need to get better?
lines.zh: : 谁告诉你你需要变好的?

lines.en: : No one.
lines.zh: : 没人。

lines.en: : I just...do.
lines.zh: : 我只是……觉得。

lines.en: : But...no.
lines.zh: : 可是……不。

lines.en: : No.
: You’re already...the best you can be.
lines.zh: : 你已经……是最好的你了。

lines.en: : You don’t need to grow any more.
lines.zh: : 你不需要再成长了。

lines.en: : You’ve done enough.
lines.zh: : 你已经做得够多了。

lines.en: : I haven’t.
lines.zh: : 我还没有。

lines.en: : And I’d appreciate it if you’d stop suffocating me.
lines.zh: : 还有,拜托你别再让我窒息了。

lines.en: scene amilockerroom31
scene black
: No.
$ amimaid50 = True
$ ami_love += 1
Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
